entries.title: Psalms 9:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. To [the tune of] "Death of the Son." A Psalm of David.>> I will praise [You], O LORD, with my whole heart; I will tell of all Your marvelous works.

entries.title: Psalms 9:2
segments: I will be glad and rejoice in You; I will sing praise to Your name, O Most High.

entries.title: Psalms 9:3
segments: When my enemies turn back, They shall fall and perish at Your presence.

entries.title: Psalms 9:4
segments: For You have maintained my right and my cause; You sat on the throne judging in righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 9:5
segments: You have rebuked the nations, You have destroyed the wicked; You have blotted out their name forever and ever.

entries.title: Psalms 9:6
segments: O enemy, destructions are finished forever! And you have destroyed cities; Even their memory has perished.

entries.title: Psalms 9:7
segments: But the LORD shall endure forever; He has prepared His throne for judgment.

entries.title: Psalms 9:8
segments: He shall judge the world in righteousness, And He shall administer judgment for the peoples in uprightness.

entries.title: Psalms 9:9
segments: The LORD also will be a refuge for the oppressed, A refuge in times of trouble.

entries.title: Psalms 9:10
segments: And those who know Your name will put their trust in You; For You, LORD, have not forsaken those who seek You.

entries.title: Psalms 9:11
segments: ¶Sing praises to the LORD, who dwells in Zion! Declare His deeds among the people.

entries.title: Psalms 9:12
segments: When He avenges blood, He remembers them; He does not forget the cry of the humble.

entries.title: Psalms 9:13
segments: Have mercy on me, O LORD! Consider my trouble from those who hate me, You who lift me up from the gates of death,

entries.title: Psalms 9:14
segments: That I may tell of all Your praise In the gates of the daughter of Zion. I will rejoice in Your salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 9:15
segments: The nations have sunk down in the pit [which] they made; In the net which they hid, their own foot is caught.

entries.title: Psalms 9:16
segments: The LORD is known [by] the judgment He executes; The wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Meditation. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 9:17
segments: The wicked shall be turned into hell, [And] all the nations that forget God.

entries.title: Psalms 9:18
segments: For the needy shall not always be forgotten; The expectation of the poor shall [not] perish forever.

entries.title: Psalms 9:19
segments: Arise, O LORD, Do not let man prevail; Let the nations be judged in Your sight.

entries.title: Psalms 9:20
segments: Put them in fear, O LORD, [That] the nations may know themselves [to be but] men. Selah
